description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveEntitlementService in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing leave entitlement management features including strategies, balance calculations, entitlement additions, and bulk assignments.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing various functionalities of the LeaveEntitlementService in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: TestEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: A mock implementation of the EntitlementConsumptionStrategy interface used for testing.

classes.name: InvalidLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: A dummy class used to test invalid class handling in getLeaveEntitlementStrategy.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategy
methods.description: Tests that the service correctly instantiates a leave entitlement strategy based on configuration.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategyNonExistClass
methods.description: Tests handling when the configured leave entitlement consumption strategy class does not exist.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategyInvalidClass
methods.description: Tests handling when the configured class does not implement the required interface.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementDao
methods.description: Verifies the DAO retrieval returns an instance of LeaveEntitlementDao.

methods.name: testGetDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIds
methods.description: Tests the logic that filters entitlements that can be deleted based on used days.

methods.name: getDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIdsDataProvider
methods.description: Provides data sets for testing deletable IDs logic.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithDates
methods.description: Checks the getLeaveBalance method with specific start and end dates.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyEndDate
methods.description: Tests getLeaveBalance when only an end date is provided.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyAsAtDate
methods.description: Tests getLeaveBalance with only an as-at date and a forced leave period.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyAsAtDateLeavePeriodNotForced
methods.description: Tests getLeaveBalance with only an as-at date when leave period isn't forced.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsNew
methods.description: Tests adding a new leave entitlement for an employee who does not have one.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsAdding
methods.description: Tests adding an entitlement to an employee who already has entitlements.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsAddingWhenDeletedAlsoThere
methods.description: Tests adding entitlement when previous entitlements existed and might have been deleted.

methods.name: testBulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Tests bulk assignment of leave entitlements to multiple employees.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixture data into the database for testing.
